label: preparing
what: A surprise tribute in the town hall for my forty years as mayor, scheduled for day 1 at 18:00 under the cover of a lighting inspection. Secretary already disclosed its purpose to me last night. Innkeeper arranges bread, Freight delivers and seeks supplies, and Builder arranges lighting and attendance. Secretary coordinates the appointment and loan requests; Baker helps seek grain for additional bread. Neighbour knowingly relays the catering funding request, though whether neighbour knows the tribute's purpose is unclear. The hall reportedly has 128 fresh loaves, with 72 more sought.
